## Requirements

From the contract's In-scope list (1–5) and design G8:

1. **Generator patch (G8-1):** `scripts/docs/adr-index.sh` parses every H1
   header form in use (`# ADR-NNN:`, `# ADR-NNN —`, `# ADR-NNN -`); owner from
   `Ticket` → `Phase` → `Phase / ticket`; status from the header field
   **and** the latest appended `## Status updates` line
   (`Superseded / Amended / Qualified / Extended / Revisited by ADR-NNN`);
   `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated (never hand-edited). Optional:
   `date_corrections.csv` "date corrected → ADR-146" marker.
2. **Index check (G8):** every index row has title, owning ticket/phase and
   status; a `—` cell is a hard failure for ADR-146+ files and for rows the
   generator could have parsed, a warning only for a genuinely absent legacy
   field (ADR-120 has no owner field at all).
3. **Supersession check (G8-2, COV-14):** an ADR named in a later ADR's
   `Supersedes:` / `Amends:` / `Qualifies:` / `Extends:` (incl. the combined
   `Amends / qualifies / extends:`) or `Relationship|Relation to landed ADRs:`
   declaration field carries the matching `- **Status:** <kind> by ADR-NNN
   (<date>)` line in its `## Status updates` section; `none` declarations,
   quoted/plan-note mentions, `leaves … unchanged`, `no status line for` and
   records-supersession phrases require nothing; `Related:`-family fields are
   bibliographic, never obligations.
4. **Trigger-register checker (G8-3):** extend SEED-15's
   `docs/build/tools/adr_triggers.py` — one row per `## Revisit trigger`,
   hash to first `### Trigger evaluation`, state grammar, ref resolution,
   evidence, `date -u` grammar, one row per waiver line — **plus** the
   open-home rule (open BL row unless quiet/superseded; the BL-002 accepted
   monitor never for `fired-unanswered`), `probe_id` honoured (G10 hook), and
   `--round-tail <round-start>` (fails a `last_evaluated` before the round or
   a `fired-unanswered` row with no S1 disposition).
5. **CI:** both checks join `make docs-check` → the CI `docs` job; each
   reports items offered/evaluated (SIG-ENG-042).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 0 index rows titled "—"; every row shows owning ticket/phase and status
      (check green on the regenerated index). *(engineered)*
- [ ] A fixture superseded ADR without the appended Status line fails; with
      it, passes. *(engineered)*
- [ ] Every trigger has one register row; edited trigger (hash mismatch),
      dangling ref and closed home each fail; appended `### Trigger
      evaluation` does not change the hash. *(engineered)*
- [ ] `--round-tail` fails a fixture with a stale `last_evaluated` and passes
      a current one. *(engineered)*
- [ ] `make check` + `make docs-check` green; a test per new behaviour; no
      living-record pin (OM-15); requirement ids stamped in the PR; ADR for
      every deviation. *(engineered)*
- [ ] PR head checks read head-bound (`ci_boundary.py`; python, docs,
      composed, security, web), recorded as `ci:`; red/pending → `blockedOn`. *(engineered)*
- [ ] Closeout = one commit after the PR exists (OM-02): run ledger, PR body,
      BUILD_INDEX row under `## Round 11` (12 cols incl. harness), LEDGER
      advanced, README `rows 1-N as of` line. *(engineered)*
- [ ] Record rules: no new verdict words needed; protected records only gain
      lines; `memory_guard.py all --staged` green before closeout. *(engineered)*

## Plan

1. Patch `scripts/docs/adr-index.sh`: generalise the status override from
   `Superseded by` to the five `Status updates` line kinds
   (Superseded/Amended/Qualified/Extended/Revisited), scoped to the
   `## Status updates` section; keep last-line-wins. Regenerate
   `docs/adr/README.md`.
2. New `docs/build/tools/adr_index_check.py` (stdlib, exit 0/1/3,
   offered/evaluated counts, `docs-check` style): regenerates the index in
   memory and diffs; flags `—` cells (viol for ADR-146+ or when the field is
   present-but-unparsed, warn for a genuinely absent legacy field); runs the
   supersession field-and-verb scan.
3. Patch `scripts/docs/check-build-memory.sh`: `—` cell becomes a violation
   for ADR-146+ and for a file whose field is present (warn only for the
   genuinely-absent legacy field).
4. Extend `docs/build/tools/adr_triggers.py`: open-home rule (reuse
   `check_backlog.py` semantics), `probe_id` token validation,
   `--round-tail <round-start>` with the S1-disposition rule; keep `check` /
   `hash` CLI plus the new flag.
5. Wire `docs-check-adr-index` + `docs-check-adr-triggers` into `docs-check`.
6. Tests: extend `docs/build/tools/test_adr_triggers.py` + new
   `docs/build/tools/test_adr_index_check.py` — fixture trees under tmp_path,
   no living-record pins (BM-TEST-01); one real-tree validator call per file
   (sanctioned channel).
